name: session-mgmt
description: Manage the full lifecycle of a Claude Code working session. start-session opens a task in a fresh, isolated git worktree (via EnterWorktree, never `git worktree add`) named after the argument, and loads the JIRA story when the name is an issue key. exit-session tears down the ephemeral resources a session created — background processes and dev servers, Docker/compose stacks, local Kubernetes clusters, git worktrees, merged local branches, and temp files — permission-free, then quits the CLI; it still confirms before destroying data (volume wipes, uncommitted work) and hands back deny-listed remote/history ops.
